- `AuthService/RequestPasswordReset` — issues a password reset token
- `AuthService/ResetPassword` — changes a login credential
- `AuthService/SendEmailLoginCode` — issues a login code
- `AuthService/Signup` — creates a user and a session
- `AuthService/SwitchWorkspace` — mints a token for another workspace
